Software

Our lab develops open-source software for molecular and systems biology. These methods are released and maintained on the Sledzieski Lab GitHub organization.

Protein Networks

📜

D-SCRIPT

Sequence-based prediction of protein-protein interactions using a protein language model. Also ships the Topsy-Turvy and TT3D models.

GitHubPyPIPaper

PHILHARMONIC

An engine for biological hypothesis generation and de novo functional inference in non-model organisms.

GitHubDatabasePyPIPaper
🌿

MINT

Protein language model trained to learn the distribution over sets of interacting protein sequences.

GitHubPaper

Phylogenetics

🌳

TreeFix-TP

Error correction for viral phylogenies based on parsimonious reconciliation with a species tree.

GitHubPaper
🧬

VirDTL

Inference of ancestral and extant strain recombination in viral genomes using phylogenetic reconciliation.

GitHubPaper

Protein Structure

❄️

Seq2Symm

Accurate and high-throughput prediction of the quaternary symmetry class of homo-oligomers using a language model.

GitHubPaper

PLANET-MD

Ultra-fast proteome-scale prediction of protein dynamics. Formerly released as RocketSHP.

GitHubPaper

Drug Discovery

💊

ConPLex

High-throughput prediction of drug-target interactions using a protein language model and contrastive learning.

GitHubPyPIPaper

Foundation Models

MIMIC

A generative multimodal foundation model for biomolecules.
